content.contents: to paddle in the wake. like doggy-paddling, idly kicking one's feet to keep afloat in the aftermath of something huge, such as, an album releasing. that's the limbo i find myself in. it's not bad or anything, in fact, the response to the album's release has been nothing short of heartwarming. the notion that there's this many people enjoying what i make, listening to something i poured my heart and soul into, it means so, so much. so, once again, thank you all for your continued support <3
so, what's been happening since the album released?

well... i've been adapting to multiple medications; i've been having serious mood swings thanks to a correction of my HRT dosage, and of course the ADHD meds (yes, i'm finally on stimulants). all the unwanted side effects do seem to be dissipating now which is nice, but for a couple weeks i was having really bizarre dreams and hot flushes in the night, waking up pooled in sweat. it wasn't fun :c
additionally, i've been working on a rather large commission that i can't share too many details of, but when the time comes you'll all definitely have a chance to hear it.

my girlfriend and i are hoping to move this year, out of this very far-right area of england. hopefully we'll head somewhere up north, there's a lot of cool music stuff going on further north anyways, so maybe that'll mean more opportunities.

we visited Scotland not long ago. i really liked it up there, it seemed so much friendlier. like england without the pertinent heyday reminiscence of the, ahem, 'glory of empire', and a touch more skepticism towards the rhetoric byproduct. that is to say, people were nice :D it was snowy too, and i love snow. i've missed it a lot since moving from CO. plus, free prescriptions, no water bills, cheaper housing, great music culture... seems like it could be ideal, but we'll see.

let's talk briefly about medication - i've been on ritalin, which has been okay. i've been kind of all over the place with it to be honest. some days it's great, other days it makes me so incredibly dissociative that i feel like i'm 17 again. when i become aware of how dissociative i feel, it's not like i can suddenly snap-to either. i instead just keep on doing whatever i was occupied with before i took notice. i don't know how to properly explain it, it's just weird. it's not so bad, but then on days where i already don't feel great, it tends to make me focus very hard on the negative feelings, and as such the moodswings can be immense and pretty detrimental. i had been told by psychiatrists that stimulants would help a lot with emotional disregulation, but on the whole i've kind of felt that it moreso gives me a consistent sense of apathy. instead of thinking of how much i hate myself for not doing the dishes, i tend to just feel nothing towards any of it. in that way, it removes barriers that were prior there. for example, a job that would've taken 5 minutes before ritalin felt like it would've taken half an hour, and so i would avoid doing it. now, i don't really care how long the job takes, i'll just do it. in fact, i don't care about much of anything. it's a double-edged sword, i don't know. that level of apathy is something alien to me. it's not like it's sociopathic or something, of course i'm still empathetic and understanding, but i don't know, i just... don't care? about things that really bothered me before?

but then, i don't know, if i see something that would usually bother me, maybe i'm able to push it aside, or rationalize the emotions associated with the material. but it's only a temporary fix. when the dose of ritalin begins to wane, then come the feelings that had prior been pushed aside or rationalized to ail me again. and the intensity of these emotions seems to feel worse than they'd have been had i not been on the medication to begin with.

creativity too feels strange. my workflow is less sporadic, but i also have less ideas. i'm able to work consistently, but i'm not sat there thinking of 600 different albums i could make, or any infinite numbers of song-clips that would make for good samples, or all the varying directions i could take the song i'm currently working on to if i had the time or patience. instead, the time and patience are kind of default, but i don't know, the song just... comes to be. it's not necessarily binary, like, it's not inherently good or bad, it just, is what it is. maybe i just need more time to adjust, i don't know.
63c6ef75-f7d6-461d-8346-7ddecf73d51a.jpg

she looks tired, doesn't she? i feel it too! part of me is riding the high of my album doing pretty good, another part of me is feeling a sort of hollowness that comes about from spilling your guts in such a way. i feel like i'm at a crossroads, but not some kinda snake-tongue fork, more like what once was quite a linear path has become a very open and vast field that i can choose to do what i'd like with, and as a result i feel kind of a self-imposed pressure to go ahead and get walking to where i want to go. the problem is, i don't know where the hell i want to go. i feel very lost and kind of wayward. like there's no clear objective other than to write more music. and sure, i'm doing that, but where there may have been directions laid out before in terms of emotional atmosphere and over-arching aesthetics for album concepts, now i feel as though if i'm going to dedicate so much time to such a project as a sophomore-successor to something like GUYAG, these concepts need to be absolutely crystal. otherwise i could end up releasing something really confused, or something i'm not very happy with, or something that'll besmirch my 'reputation' (or lack thereof?) ... i guess i'll just write and see what comes of it, but if i'm going to live in the moment like i've been telling myself to, i need to stop with the pressure. easier said than done T^T

i've had a fair amount of people reach out to me since the album's release, telling me about their experiences with it, what they liked about it, how it made them feel, what they got out of it. means a lot. nothing means more to me than someone taking the time out of their day to actually message or email me and share their thoughts, it's just such a sweet thing to do. i always feel kind of honored. like, really? me? my music? what i made gave you these profound feelings? that's been the goal since the beginning, so to see it come to fruition is just, incomprehensibly meaningful. i guess - as stupid as it sounds - i've always had such an attraction to music, i've kind of felt like i'm just here on this planet to make it. not that it's some divine ordination, just, even if it's the last thing i'm doing in my dying moments, even if nobody is sat there listening, it's something i'm always going to do. as such, it's really nice that as it stands there are a fair amount of people willing to tune in. thank you so much, guys!! :D
foul temptress dressed in alluring silver and white. my weakness. something i love. something i lost along the days i need to focus.
what else... or, i guess, what's next?

alright FINE i GUESS i'll answer you... uhhhh... i have a lot of written songs that i may try out in an upcoming gig. you may have actually seen an advertisement for this gig on a post i made to youtube, but in case you didn't, here's the gig flier.

it's a slim chance, but hey, if you're around the area, why not come say hi?

by the way - for a while my mascot was (stupidly) called statty. but i've decided that name is DUMB and FUCKING STUPID. so NOW... she's going to be named stacy, because sta... and ... c... they're all letters that can also be found in the word static. i think. don't quote me on that i've never been good at spleling. haha, you wanna see some spelling errors? try reading my diary, where there's no spell-check aside from my solvent-abused noggin! on second thought, please do not read my diary. just stick to the blogs, at least i've got some kind of parasocial filter here. if you think the depressive sadposting found on here is bad, hoo boy.

stacy in the above flier is holding an acoustic guitar! this is because i'll be performing some motherfucking acoustic music! i'm trying out some material. it's not a DJ set, it's a live acoustic gig. maybe you'll like it! maybe you won't show up! i don't fucking care do whatever the hell you want!!! it's not like it matters to me!!!!!!!!!!!!!1

i got my hair dyed! it looks very scene at the moment. of course, i won't share any photos to maintain my air of internet mystique... but wait, if i'm doing a live acoustic gig, then there's a chance people will see my face... shit. well, i guess i'll never post my face to official channels of my own. for the foreseeable. maybe that'll change hell if i know!

i'm tired, i'm hungry, i feel slightly sad for no apparent reason, as such i'm going to go. but you all should know i love you and i want to thank you all one more time for the reception to GUYAG. it's been a dream come true. you're all wonderful. as always, you can always reach out to me via email @ static.grl.digital@gmail.com !! feel free to drop me a line :3
time to drift around and see what happens. much love,
